import numpy as np
rate_ladder = 8/60  # kg/s from Chondrobot-2 8kg/min
rate_scraper = 2/60  # kg/s conservative scraper
target = 15  # kg per trip
t = np.arange(0,1200)
fill_ladder = np.minimum(rate_ladder*t, target)
fill_scraper = np.minimum(rate_scraper*t, target)
t_ladder = target/rate_ladder
t_scraper = target/rate_scraper
print(f"ladder to 15kg: {t_ladder:.0f} s; scraper to 15kg: {t_scraper:.0f} s")
print(f"hopper 20L at 1500kg/m3 = 30kg max; 15kg = half full")
